title: Spicy Indian Pasta Bake
description: A unique fusion of Indian spices and Italian pasta, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. This Spicy Indian Pasta Bake is a flavorful and spicy take on traditional pasta bake.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the Indian spice blend (quintessential) over medium heat.
Add the red pepper flakes (spicy) and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the sour cream (croatian) and cook until heated through.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, spicy sauce, and shredded mozzarella (cheese).
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional mozzarella cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
